subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Blow-Off: Making Victims Stay Silent
description: One-minute skill: The Blow-Off: Making Victims Stay Silent.

hook.text: A fraud victim never calls the police. The con artist made sure of that.

buildup.text: The 'blow-off' is how con artists ensure victims stay quiet after the scam.

discovery.text: Victims stay silent from shame, complicity, or fear that reporting exposes their own greed.

twist.text: Some cons even make victims believe they did something illegal, trapping them into silence.

climax.text: The blow-off is why most cons are never reported. Silence is the scammer's final weapon.

punchline.text: The best scam is one the victim never admits happened.

quiz.question: Why do many con victims stay silent?
options: Shame, fear, or belief they did something illegal too
The amounts are too small to report
